name: Disjoint Set Mesh Optimization
definition: An optimization pipeline that first culls occluded faces using a voxel occlusion algorithm, then processes the remaining visible faces plane-by-plane using a disjoint set data structure to merge adjacent quads.
summary: Disjoint Set Mesh Optimization is a voxel meshing pipeline that combines occlusion culling with plane-wise quad merging to produce compact meshes, differing from its parent by operating on full 3D chunks.
